description: Read the inbox of a long-term SMS rental: all received messages, newest first, plus the number's status and expiry. Read-only; poll it when the user expects a message. The receiptId comes from rent_sms_number or list_sms_orders. Requires a connected agent wallet.

receiptId.description: The rental receipt ID from rent_sms_number or list_sms_orders

name: get_sms_rental_messages
